This operation performs irreversible deletion of a todo. When a todo is permanently deleted, it is completely removed from the system along with all its edit history records. This action cannot be undone and the data cannot be recovered.

Users must have ownership of the todo to perform this operation. The system validates that the todo exists before proceeding with deletion. This operation follows strict data integrity rules by deleting all related records in a single atomic transaction.

For safety, users should first verify they are deleting the correct todo before performing permanent deletion. This ensures they understand the irreversible nature of this action.

responseBody.description: Confirmation of successful permanent deletion

access.description:

This token must be included in the Authorization header using the Bearer
scheme (e.g., `Authorization: Bearer {access}`) for all endpoints requiring

activity. If refresh token rotation is enabled, this deadline may extend
with each successful refresh.

session renewal capabilities.

credentials. This structure is automatically included in authentication
responses across all generated backend applications.
